name: Ham's Game Store Simulator
detailed_description:
🏪 Welcome to Ham's Game Store Simulator!

Step into the nostalgic world of retro consoles, midnight launches, and bargain bin treasures. In Ham's Game Store Simulator, you take control of your very own video game shop. Stock shelves, serve customers, and turn your humble store into the ultimate gaming destination.

📦 Build, Manage, and Expand

Run the day-to-day operations of your store:

Restock shelves with the latest releases and vintage finds

Set prices, manage budgets, and handle the occasional picky customer

Upgrade your layout, decorate your store, and unlock new features

🎮 Play the Games You Sell

Take a break from the business and actually play the games! Test out your inventory, beat high scores, and relive pixelated classics—your arcade cabinet might just become the hottest spot in town.

🎯 Collect Rare and Legendary Titles

Scour supplier catalogs, attend shady back-alley deals, and keep your eye out for rare games and limited-edition consoles. From boxed gems to forgotten cult classics, building your personal collection is half the fun.

🎉 Host Launch Events and Tournaments

Hype up new game releases with launch parties, in-store tournaments, and midnight madness sales. A well-planned event could skyrocket your store’s reputation!

🕹 A Love Letter to Gaming Culture

With nods to gaming history and a relaxing, cozy gameplay loop, Ham's Game Store Simulator is perfect for anyone who’s ever dreamed of running their own game shop. Whether you're in it for the business or the nostalgia, there’s something here for every gamer.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 @ 3,3 GHz (4 CPUs)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1050
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
